content_model_areas.name: Worker Characteristics
content_model_areas.learning_use: Career exploration and role-fit explanation only; do not infer sensitive traits or make employment decisions about people.

official_release_snapshot.note: These counts are a verified release snapshot from the O*NET 31.0 database, not permanent constants. Refresh version and source hashes on every data update.

ai_task_suitability.rule: Every O*NET task must receive a task-specific capability assessment; occupation category alone cannot determine automation suitability.

classes.description: AI can research, explain, draft, summarize, classify, calculate or prepare a recommendation; human verifies consequential outputs.
AI may execute a digital workflow only with least privilege, deterministic validation, approved tools, audit logging, rollback and required human approval.
A qualified human must retain professional judgment, authorization, sign-off or legally required oversight.
Task requires physical presence, specialized equipment, licensed operation, direct sensory assessment or real-world safety controls; AI alone cannot perform it.
Evidence is insufficient; block autonomous execution and queue research.

ai_task_suitability.no_go: Do not infer licensure, professional competence, safety clearance, authority to act, or ability to perform physical work from O*NET task data.

required_sections: cost and unit economics where relevant
per_task_playbook.revenue_pathway: Only where legitimate demand, buyer authority, lawful scope, truthful capability evidence, licensing and insurance constraints, costs and delivery feasibility are established.

truth_boundary: This is a complete subject taxonomy and task-playbook standard, not proof Buddy can safely perform every occupation or that all task guides and runtime capabilities have been implemented.
